say:2:1010622001:0.text: Look at that clearing surrounded by ruins. I think those mercenaries are guarding something over there!
say:2:1010622001:0.source_cn: 看那片被遗迹环绕的空地，佣兵先生们好像在守护着什么东西！

say:6:1010622003:0.text: Do I have to keep saying it? Look, Lord Franz has been...
say:6:1010622003:0.source_cn: 我已经不想再浪费口舌了，弗朗茨他——

say:7:1010622004:0.text: I know exactly what happened to Lord Franz.
say:7:1010622004:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨的事我已经听说了。

say:8:1010622005:0.text:
Then why are you still blocking our way?
Are your lives really worth the money he paid you?
say:8:1010622005:0.source_cn: 既然如此，为什么还要阻挡我们？\n弗朗茨付给你们的钱，...

say:9:1010622006:0.text: Or maybe he promised you riches beyond your wildest dreams if you protected this place? Because let me tell you, you're dreaming if you believe him.
say:9:1010622006:0.source_cn: 还是说，他蒙骗你们可以借助身后遗迹里的东西点石成金，你...

say:10:1010622007:0.text: I don't know what we're guarding here, and I don't care to know what you're doing here.
say:10:1010622007:0.source_cn: 我不知道自己在守卫什么，也无意探听你们前来的动机。

say:11:1010622008:0.text: But a deal is a deal. We were paid to guard this place, and that's what we're going to do.
say:11:1010622008:0.source_cn: 契约已签，收钱办事，是我们职责所在。

say:12:1010622009:0.text: You don't need to uphold a contract with Lord Franz, you know? He's not exactly a good person.
say:12:1010622009:0.source_cn: 不用那么遵守契约吧，毕竟弗朗茨也不是什么好人。

say:13:1010622010:0.text: Our honor depends on it. What kind of future will we have as mercenaries if we abandon our post simply because our client got arrested?
say:13:1010622010:0.source_cn: 我们的信誉就来自于此，雇主被捕就擅离职守，今后谁还会信...

say:14:1010622011:0.text: So please, leave now before we're forced to carry out our duties.
say:14:1010622011:0.source_cn: 请回，否则我们只能履行职责！

say:15:1010622012:0.text: I understand. You're not wrong for being loyal, but you placed your loyalty on the wrong person.
say:15:1010622012:0.source_cn: 嗯，明白了。我不讨厌忠诚，前提是那份忠诚奉献给了对的人。

say:16:1010622013:0.source_cn: 拔剑吧，为彼此效忠的对象而战！
